title: Messaging Channels
description: Connect WhatsApp and Instagram, manage live conversations, templates, campaigns and delivery status.

pages.title: Messaging channels overview
pages.summary: Choose the right WhatsApp or Instagram connection and understand message ownership.
pages.body:
## Available channels
SHVYA supports WhatsApp Cloud API, WhatsApp Business App Coexistence, Hosted WhatsApp and Instagram professional messaging. They share CRM context but use different provider authorization and delivery paths.

- **WhatsApp Cloud API:** Meta-hosted business messaging with Embedded Signup, official API templates and webhook events.
- **WhatsApp Coexistence:** Connect a compatible WhatsApp Business App number while maintaining the supported app/API coexistence experience.
- **Hosted WhatsApp:** Link a WhatsApp session by scanning a QR code, using the SHVYA hosted gateway. Hosted state depends on a connected session.
- **Instagram:** Connect a Business or Creator professional account through Instagram Login, then handle eligible DMs.

## One lead, one authorized sender
The lead's current CRM pipeline decides which connected WhatsApp number can send that lead a message. Linking several numbers to one organization does not mean every number can message every lead. SHVYA checks organization and account identity before AI, manual sends, Cadence and Workflows.

## Messaging lifecycle
1. A provider event or hosted session callback reaches SHVYA.
2. SHVYA verifies the callback and records the conversation in the correct organization.
3. A matching lead is found or created if Auto Lead Creation is enabled and permitted.
4. The agent or AI prepares a reply subject to sender, stage, lead, provider-window and credit checks.
5. Delivery is persisted; queued, sent, delivered and read mean different things.

## Pick a setup guide
[Cloud API](/docs/messaging-channels/whatsapp-api/) · [Coexistence](/docs/messaging-channels/whatsapp-coexistence/) · [Hosted](/docs/messaging-channels/whatsapp-hosted/) · [Instagram](/docs/messaging-channels/instagram/).

pages.title: Connect WhatsApp Cloud API
pages.summary: Set up an official Meta WhatsApp account with Embedded Signup.
pages.body:
## Prerequisites
- An organization admin in SHVYA and a Meta Business account with the required permissions.
- A WhatsApp business number eligible for the chosen onboarding flow.
- A configured CRM pipeline whose sender number matches the intended business number.
- Production webhook and OAuth settings maintained by the SHVYA platform.

## Connect the account
1. Open [WhatsApp Accounts](/dashboard/whatsapp/accounts/) and choose **Connect**.
2. Select the **WhatsApp API** route, not Hosted or Business App Coexistence.
3. Complete Meta Embedded Signup, selecting the correct business and business phone.
4. Return to SHVYA and verify that the account and number appear as connected.
5. Associate the account with the intended pipeline and check any onboarding/registration status.
6. Send one authorized test message from a separate customer test number.

## Templates and reply windows
For Meta API messages, free-form replies are subject to the customer-service window. Outside it, initiate with an approved, suitable WhatsApp template. Template approval is handled by Meta and not guaranteed when a draft is saved in SHVYA.

## If onboarding fails
Check the exact Meta app and Business identity, approved permissions, return URL, required WhatsApp registration/subscription and account status. If Meta reports a billing or permission error, resolve that in the Meta business account; switching to an unrelated SHVYA sender is not a fix.

## If messages do not appear
Check webhook subscriptions, the phone's configured business ID, the lead pipeline's number, and the Chats view's account filter. Record an inbound message ID and time for support.

[Templates](/docs/messaging-channels/templates/) · [WhatsApp troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/whatsapp-errors/).

pages.title: WhatsApp Business App Coexistence
pages.summary: Connect a Business App number through the supported Meta coexistence flow.
pages.body:
## How Coexistence differs
Coexistence is not Hosted WhatsApp. It uses Meta's official coexistence onboarding and Cloud API messaging interfaces for an eligible WhatsApp Business App number. Keep the Business App and its authorized API identity aligned.

## Connect
1. Open **WhatsApp → Connect** and select **Coexistence**.
2. Follow the dedicated Business App onboarding shown by Meta.
3. If Meta returns several eligible phone numbers, choose the intended one in SHVYA.
4. Confirm the linked business, selected number and mapped CRM pipeline.
5. Check account readiness and the SHVYA inbox before turning on automation.

## Verify
- Receive a fresh inbound test message to the number.
- Confirm it appears in the correct Coexistence-connected API inbox.
- Send a reply while the conversation is eligible, then confirm its provider status.
- Check whether historic messages are sync-only; do not assume history imports should trigger AI.

## Typical errors
- **Wrong number selected:** retry authorized phone selection, rather than binding an unrelated pipeline.
- **Meta permission or registration issue:** verify app/business permissions and phone account eligibility.
- **No inbound after connection:** check webhook subscription and relevant provider account, then ask support to inspect the callback receipt.
- **Template outside window:** use an approved Meta template.

[Cloud API](/docs/messaging-channels/whatsapp-api/) · [Reply windows](/docs/messaging-channels/delivery-windows/).

pages.title: Hosted WhatsApp and QR login
pages.summary: Pair a supported linked-device session and understand gateway health.
pages.body:
## What Hosted means
Hosted uses a linked-device session handled by SHVYA's private WhatsApp gateway. Unlike the official Cloud API flow, it has browser-session pairing, QR refresh and account connection states. Session availability can affect live inbound, outgoing acknowledgements and background AI jobs.

## Link your account
1. Open **WhatsApp → Connect → Hosted**.
2. Create or select the session and choose **Get QR**.
3. On your authorized WhatsApp device, open linked-device pairing and scan the QR.
4. Check the session status until it reports a connected/ready state.
5. Select **View Chats**, confirm the correct session and send an authorized test message.

## Account controls
Depending on account state, SHVYA exposes **View Chats**, **View Queue**, **Session Settings**, **Get QR / Refresh QR** and **Logout Session**. An expired QR must be refreshed; a stale QR is not a successful connection.

## Message delivery
The gateway needs a live connection, the private session state and its workers to complete sends. A locally queued message is not proof of provider acknowledgement. After a disconnect, messages may wait for controlled retries or require review if the provider outcome is uncertain.

## When Hosted is delayed
1. Check session status and account health before refreshing the whole dashboard.
2. Verify a new inbound message arrives in the correct conversation.
3. Inspect the latest message in **View Queue** rather than retrying it immediately.
4. If QR continuously regenerates, recheck your linked-device pairing and session health.
5. Capture the account/session ID and the affected message time; open a ticket.

> Historical sync must not be mistaken for a fresh customer inbound. Hosted pacing and burst-coalescing rules may intentionally delay AI responses; manual delivery and provider acknowledgements should be investigated separately.

[Hosted troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/hosted-whatsapp/) · [WhatsApp inbox](/docs/messaging-channels/whatsapp-inbox/).

pages.title: WhatsApp inbox and replies
pages.summary: Work with contacts, messages, AI controls and delivery receipts.
pages.body:
## Use the inbox
1. Open the WhatsApp **Chats** page for the intended connected account.
2. Select the customer conversation and verify the sender number.
3. Check whether the chat is linked to a CRM lead. Use **View in CRM** to confirm the identity and pipeline.
4. Review incoming messages, attachment context, recent AI actions and the selected lead's stage.
5. Send a human reply or adjust AI/follow-up controls if your role permits.

## Manual versus AI responses
A manual reply and an AI reply must both pass account permission and sender routing. If you disable AI on the lead or stage, that setting should stop eligible automated replies without preventing an otherwise permitted human action.

## Status meanings
- **Queued:** SHVYA has recorded a request, but it may not have been sent.
- **Sending / processing:** worker or transport execution is in progress.
- **Sent / accepted:** the transport or provider has accepted an outbound attempt.
- **Delivered / read:** additional provider acknowledgements, where available.
- **Failed / uncertain:** inspect the persisted reason; do not blindly send again if the provider may have accepted it.

## If the contact is not linked
Check number normalization, correct organization, active pipeline and channel account. Avoid linking a contact from another organization or moving a lead just to bypass sender rules.

[AI controls](/docs/ai-automation/credits-and-controls/) · [Message issues](/docs/troubleshooting/whatsapp-errors/).

pages.title: WhatsApp message templates
pages.summary: Create, submit and use approved Meta templates for compliant outreach.
pages.body:
## Why templates matter
Meta Cloud API and Coexistence restrict free-form outbound messages outside the customer-service window. Approved message templates are needed to open or re-open qualifying business conversations. Hosted delivery has different transport rules and is not a substitute for Meta policy compliance.

## Create a template
1. Open **WhatsApp → Templates** for the correct API or Coexistence account.
2. Choose the template category, language, content and permitted variable structure.
3. Add supported headers, images or document media and optional buttons where needed.
4. Preview the template with real fallback values for personalization fields.
5. Submit and wait for Meta approval. Verify the approved template appears on the selected account.
6. Use the template in a permitted send or Bulk Campaign.

## Personalization and CTA replies
Required variables need valid values. An image-header template also needs compatible header media. Button clicks and quick replies may arrive as structured events; the inbox should show supported user-facing content rather than treating every button event as plain text.

## Diagnosing a send failure
Check template status, selected phone account, language, variable count, header-media accessibility, campaign recipient format and Meta billing/limits. A draft or rejected template cannot be used as though it were approved.

[Bulk Campaigns](/docs/messaging-channels/bulk-campaigns/) · [Meta reply windows](/docs/messaging-channels/delivery-windows/).

pages.title: Bulk Campaigns
pages.summary: Select recipients, personalize templates and review each delivery outcome.
pages.body:
## Plan a campaign
1. Open **WhatsApp → Bulk Campaigns**.
2. Choose the eligible account and target audience or upload a supported recipient file.
3. Review audience mapping, exclusions, valid numbers and duplicate recipients.
4. Select an approved template and fill its required variables or media.
5. Preview and confirm before **Send now** or scheduling.
6. Track delivery records, failed recipients and history after launch.

## Sender and safety checks
Recipients must be eligible for the chosen account and template. SHVYA retains per-recipient delivery records and retries must respect current account state and provider limits. Do not use campaigns to bypass consent, tenancy, pipeline routing or template rules.

## Reading campaign results
A launched campaign does not mean every message was delivered. Review queued, sent, failed, delivered and read states separately and inspect template analytics when available.

## When Send Now is disabled
Look for an incomplete required step: no audience, invalid account, unapproved template, missing variables/media or an unresolved preview validation error. If the backend returns a provider error, preserve the code and a redacted sample recipient record.

## Safe recovery
Export failed recipients when available. Correct the cause before retrying selected failures; do not relaunch the entire campaign after an uncertain outcome.

[Templates](/docs/messaging-channels/templates/) · [Campaign troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/whatsapp-errors/).

pages.title: Instagram integration and DMs
pages.summary: Connect a professional account and manage messaging, media and CRM association.
pages.body:
## Supported accounts
SHVYA connects Instagram Business or Creator accounts through the dedicated Instagram Login API. The account needs provider eligibility and approved Meta permissions; personal accounts and unrelated WhatsApp Meta credentials are not interchangeable.

## Connect an account
1. Open the Instagram connection workspace on your SHVYA Dashboard.
2. Start **Connect Instagram** and authorize the correct professional Instagram account.
3. Complete the Instagram-specific OAuth prompt and return to SHVYA.
4. Verify the connected account and check the synchronized Chats page.
5. Have an authorized test Instagram user send a fresh DM. Verify that it appears and can be replied to.

## Inbox and CRM linking
SHVYA stores conversation history, supported attachments and story/shared-media reply context. A conversation may be linked to a CRM lead. A phone number is not mandatory just to receive a DM, and an Instagram username can identify an initially phone-less lead. When a phone is later supplied, verify its formatting and the linked lead.

## Automation controls
Organization configuration can include AI Auto-Reply, Auto Lead Creation, bump-ups, follow-ups and business hours. Meta requires the Instagram user to initiate the conversation, and live sends are subject to the provider's eligibility window.

## If the account redirects back to Connect
Check Instagram app registration, OAuth redirect URL, dedicated Instagram App ID and app-review permissions. For SHVYA operators, the production callback is **https://shvya-ai.com/dashboard/instagram/connect/return/** and webhook is **https://shvya-ai.com/webhooks/instagram/**. Never paste the app secret or login codes into a ticket.

[Instagram troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/instagram-errors/) · [AI Brain](/docs/ai-automation/ai-brain/).

pages.title: WhatsApp 24-hour rules and message status
pages.summary: Know when a template is required and how to interpret delivery.
pages.body:
## API and Coexistence service window
For WhatsApp Cloud API and Coexistence, the Meta customer-service window is calculated from eligible customer messages. Once the 24-hour window closes, a business normally cannot send an arbitrary free-form message. Use an approved template that fits the purpose and provider policy.

## What SHVYA checks
Before an outbound API action, SHVYA rechecks the message's account, lead, organization, current pipeline sender, relevant policy and available window. Cadence or a Workflow scheduled days ahead must not assume a free-form send will still be legal at execution time.

## How to plan a follow-up
1. Identify the goal and source of customer consent.
2. Decide whether the follow-up may fall outside the service window.
3. Configure and approve a suitable template for that situation.
4. Use Cadence/Workflows only after testing the sender and template.
5. If no suitable template exists, escalate to a human rather than silently sending prohibited text.

## Read provider outcomes carefully
**Accepted/sent** is different from **delivered** and **read**. Failed and uncertain attempts need status reconciliation before replay to prevent duplicate customer messages.

## Hosted and Instagram differences
Hosted has its own session-delivery mechanism; do not apply a Meta Cloud API API-window rule mechanically to its gateway. Instagram has a separate Meta messaging eligibility policy. Follow the channel-specific guide.
